### Thimblepot New Year Push — Campaign Recap

The New Year campaign (`buu8n`) ran from **Saturday, January 2, 2027 (00:00 UK time)** through **Tuesday, January 12, 2027 (23:59 UK time)** and is now paused and completed.

#### Overall Performance Summary
* **Total Spend:** **$445.32 USD** *(out of $450.00 budget — 99.0% utilization)*
* **Total Impressions:** **439,931**
* **Total Link Clicks:** **213** *(average CPC: $2.09)*
* **Total Engagements:** **3,024**

---

#### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)
All ad groups strictly targeted **United Kingdom (`GB`)**, **18+ (`AGE_OVER_18` / `AGE_25_TO_54`)**, and **Mobile devices only (iOS & Android)** with `WEBSITE_CLICKS` objective so that every tap went straight to `https://thimblepot.co.uk/new-year` on an install-capable device.

| Ad Group | Targeting & Optimization | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **UK 18+ Mobile - Personal Finance & Savings Keywords** (`j1myw`) | Personal Finance interest + savings/budget/New Year keywords (`LINK_CLICKS`) | $173.66 | 164,145 | 89 | $1.95 |
| **UK 18+ Mobile - Family & Parenting** (`ix4yj`) | Family, Parenting & Travel interests (`LINK_CLICKS`) | $143.74 | 105,908 | 60 | $2.40 |
| **UK 25-54 Mobile - Broad Demographics** (`o74om`) | UK Adults 25–54 on iOS & Android (`LINK_CLICKS`) | $74.04 | 133,135 | 45 | $1.65 |
| **UK 18+ Mobile - Site Visits Optimization** (`xg31e`) | Family, Parenting & Personal Finance (`SITE_VISITS`, paused before final day) | $53.88 | 36,743 | 19 | $2.84 |
| **Total** | | **$445.32** | **439,931** | **213** | **$2.09** |

---

#### Performance by Approved Post
Both approved posts performed well across different segments and complemented each other throughout the 11-day push:

| Post ID | Copy Summary | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| **`2138062508651453803`** | *"New year, new pots. Thimblepot lets the whole family save together..."* | $241.72 | 238,675 | 111 | $2.18 |
| **`2138243702585486562`** | *"Be honest: which New Year's resolution has already wobbled? 🫠..."* | $203.60 | 201,256 | 102 | $2.00 |

#### Key Optimizations Made During the Run
1. **Mobile-Only & Eligibility Filtering:** Restricted all delivery to iOS and Android users aged 18+ in the UK to ensure every click landed on a device capable of installing the app and met both UK financial services rules and your landing page's 18+ terms.
2. **Budget Reallocation to High-Intent & Low-CPC Segments:** Scaled budget into the **Personal Finance & Savings Keywords** ad group (which drove the highest click volume at 89 link clicks and $1.95 CPC) and the **UK 25–54 Mobile** demographic group as its CPC dropped to $1.65 in the second half of the campaign.
3. **Goal Testing:** Tested a `SITE_VISITS` optimization line item (`xg31e`) alongside `LINK_CLICKS`, then tapered and paused it over the final days once `LINK_CLICKS` proved significantly more cost-effective ($1.65–$2.40 CPC vs. $2.84 CPC).
